```{r}
# Q1
data("trees")
head(trees)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(trees, aes(x = Girth)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "blue", color = "black") + labs(title="Distribution of Girth")
```
```{r}
# Q2
data("trees")
head(trees)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(trees, aes(x = Volume)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "pink", color = "black") + labs(title="Distribution of Volume")
```

```{r}
# Q3
data("trees")
head(trees)
data(trees)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(trees, aes(x= Girth, y = Volume)) +
  geom_point(color = "green", size = 2) + labs(title= "Girth vs Volume", x = "Girth", y = "Volume")
```
```{r}
# Q4

shapiro.test(trees$Volume)

# NOT A NORMAL DISTRIBUTION.
```

```{r}
# Q5

shapiro.test(trees$Girth)

```
